job.title: Fab Reporting Business Analyst @ imec (Leuven, VLG, BE)
job.description:
Engineering - Leuven | Just now

As a Fab Reporting Business Analyst, you help shape the future of data-driven operations in one of the world's most advanced semiconductor R&D environments

As a Fab Reporting Business Analyst, you enable imec's Pilot Lines and Operations teams to make better and faster decisions through trusted operational data, analytics, and reporting solutions. You act as the bridge between business stakeholders, Fab operations, and ICT teams, translating operational needs into sustainable reporting solutions and data products that improve visibility, efficiency, quality, and decision-making across the organization. Rather than simply building reports, you help define how operational data is transformed into actionable insights, ensuring solutions are aligned with business processes, governance standards, and long-term strategic objectives.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Partner with Fab stakeholders to understand operational challenges, processes, and information needs.
* Translate business requirements into reporting solutions, dashboards, and data products that support operational decision-making. You create prototypes and/or wireframes to validate proposals with requesters.
* Create wireframes, prototypes, and functional specifications to align solutions with stakeholder expectations.
* Validate KPIs, business rules, data quality, performance, and governance requirements.
* Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and developers to deliver scalable reporting solutions.
* Coordinate testing activities and ensure solutions meet business needs before release.
* Support users through documentation, training, issue investigation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to reporting governance, standardization, and the evolution of self-service analytics across the Fab.

**What we do for you**
----------------------

We offer you the opportunity to join one of the world’s premier research centers in nanotechnology at its headquarters in Leuven, Belgium. With your talent, passion and expertise, you’ll become part of a team that makes the impossible possible. Together, we shape the technology that will define the society of tomorrow.

We are committed to being an inclusive employer and proud of our open, multicultural, and informal working environment with ample possibilities to take initiative and show responsibility. We commit to supporting and guiding you in this process; not only with words but also with tangible actions. Through imec.academy, 'our corporate university', we actively invest in your development to further your technical and personal growth.

We are aware that your valuable contribution makes imec a top player in its field. Your energy and commitment are therefore appreciated by means of a market appropriate salary with many fringe benefits.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You hold a Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Exact Sciences, or have equivalent experience.
* You are passionate about turning data into actionable insights and helping stakeholders make better decisions.
* You have experience with data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, or data modelling.
* You can quickly understand complex operational processes and translate business needs into practical solutions.
* You are an engaged listener who enjoys collaborating with stakeholders from different technical and business backgrounds.
* You communicate clearly and can explain data, concepts, and solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* You are proactive, curious, and not afraid to challenge assumptions or dive into unfamiliar topics.
* You can work independently, take ownership of your work, and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Experience with Power BI, SQL, Power Query, self-service analytics, or modern data platforms is considered a strong asset.
* Experience in manufacturing, process industries, or semiconductor environments is a plus.
* You are fluent in English and enjoy working in a highly international environment. You have minimum 2 years experience with data analysis, manipulation, visualization or data modelling for analytics (e.g., Kimball)
  

*IMEC and its affiliates will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. IMEC will consider unsolicited referrals and/or resumes submitted by vendors such as search firms, staffing agencies, professional recruiters, fee-based referral services and recruiting agencies (hereafter “Agency”) to have been referred by the Agency free of charge. IMEC will not pay a fee to any Agency that does not have a prior written agreement with IMEC, validated by its HR department, in place regarding a specific job opening and allowing to submit resumes.*
